item.title: Judson Mill wins AIA Greenville 2025 Honor Award
item.description: Judson Mill earned the AIA Greenville 2025 Honor Award for adaptive reuse, recognizing its $160M redevelopment in Greenville County. The post Judson Mill wins AIA Greenville 2025 Honor Award appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Lowcountry Land Trust protects 50 acres on Johns Island
item.description: Lowcountry Land Trust secured permanent protection of 50 acres on Johns Island through a conservation easement funded by Charleston County Greenbelt. The post Lowcountry Land Trust protects 50 acres on Johns Island appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Best at Work Insights: The choice we’re making about AI
item.description: CEOs report AI time savings but workers do not, highlighting training gaps, productivity challenges and rising workplace loneliness. The post Best at Work Insights: The choice we’re making about AI appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Six Nineteen of 1865 launches e-commerce nationwide
item.description: Upstate minority-owned liquor brand Six Nineteen of 1865 launches e-commerce, shipping ready-to-drink cocktails to 43 states and D.C. The post Six Nineteen of 1865 launches e-commerce nationwide appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Goodwill opens Clean Tech Lab in Columbia
item.description: Goodwill opens Midlands Clean Tech Accelerator Lab in Columbia, offering paid training in heat pumps, solar and EVSE for clean energy jobs. The post Goodwill opens Clean Tech Lab in Columbia appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Goldrich Kest buys Summerville warehouse
item.description: Goldrich Kest acquired a 448,765-square-foot Summerville warehouse at Charleston Trade Center, marking its first South Carolina purchase. The post Goldrich Kest buys Summerville warehouse appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Palmetto Citizens FCU names CFO, COO
item.description: Palmetto Citizens Federal Credit Union appointed a new CFO and COO and named a special adviser to the CEO as part of succession planning. The post Palmetto Citizens FCU names CFO, COO appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Boeing 787 order to power new Vietnam-based airline
item.description: Sun PhuQuoc Airways orders up to 40 Boeing 787 Dreamliners assembled in North Charleston, marking Vietnam’s largest widebody jet deal. The post Boeing 787 order to power new Vietnam-based airline appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Greenville Triumph delays GE Vernova Park opener
item.description: Greenville Triumph moves its GE Vernova Park opener to June 3 after winter storms delayed stadium readiness at BridgeWay Station. The post Greenville Triumph delays GE Vernova Park opener appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Le Creuset opens Hampton County distribution hub
item.description: Le Creuset opens a 300000-square-foot distribution facility in Hampton County, adding 30 jobs and expanding its Lowcountry operations. The post Le Creuset opens Hampton County distribution hub appeared first on SCBiz.
